items.title: XCF Global and Posh Energy Sign Letter of Intent to Deploy Flex-Fuel Gensets
items.summary: Posh and XCF Global (NASDAQ: SAFX) signed a letter of intent to deploy up to 10MW of flex-fuel gensets that transform renewable fuel into electricity to power data centers.

items.title: Posh Electric Awarded Singapore EMA Grant for 1MWh Sodium-ion Battery Trial
items.summary: Singapore's Energy Market Authority awarded Posh Electric a grant to deploy a 1MWh sodium-ion battery energy storage system — integrating 600 kW of rooftop solar with A*STAR's IMRE and Utraco — validating the chemistry-agnostic battery intelligence behind every Posh deployment.

items.title: Commercial & Industrial Energy Use at a Turning Point
items.summary: In 2025, commercial and industrial users will consume nearly 60% of U.S. electricity. This article lays out the challenges that come with such massive energy usage and the opportunities for C&I leaders to turn this scale to their advantage.

items.title: Energy In, Tokens Out
items.summary: AI's future is constrained by energy, not computing power. AI's immense energy demands are outpacing efficiency gains, creating a "Jevons paradox." This necessitates a shift in focus towards energy supply and infrastructure. Companies must now evaluate their energy capacity with the same rigor as their digital assets. Renewable energy and battery storage systems (BESS) are crucial solutions. BESS helps data centers manage dynamic energy demands, reduce grid stress, and accelerate interconnection, making robust, intelligently managed power the key to unlocking AI's next phase.

items.title: Off the Grid: The Rise of Commercial Energy Independence
items.summary: Solar and battery systems are helping C&I facilities turn peak power into profit—demand response is reshaping the business case for going off-grid.

items.title: Navigating DSA Requirements for BESS and Streamlining Deployment with Posh Energy’s Cabinet Solution
items.summary: Deploying battery energy storage systems (BESS) in California's public sector requires navigating complex structural, fire, and electrical codes. Posh Energy's pre-engineered cabinet solution simplifies compliance, accelerates DSA approval, reduces costs, and offers flexible, modular deployment. EPC developers and facility managers benefit from streamlined processes, predictable timelines, and regulatory ease.

items.title: Solving Peak Energy Demands: Smart Battery Solutions for Commercial Buildings
items.summary: Smart battery solutions are transforming energy management in commercial buildings by tackling peak energy demand and reducing high utility costs, which can account for up to 70% of monthly bills. These systems deploy smart technologies and AI analytics to enhance energy efficiency, leading to substantial savings on electricity bills, often exceeding tens of thousands annually.

items.title: Energy Storage for EV Fleet Charging: Stanford University’s Bus Depot Case Study
items.summary: Stanford slashed EV fleet emissions by 98% and saved $3.7M using solar power and battery storage. Learn how energy storage boosts sustainability and cost savings.

items.title: Battery Fires in Focus: Dissecting the Moss Landing Incident
items.summary: In light of the Moss Landing fire, we share our thoughts on the causes, impact and approaches to make sure how such incidents can be prevented in the future.

items.title: Maximize Solar ROI with POSH Battery Solutions | Beat NEM 3.0 & Tariff Hikes
items.summary: POSH helps solar owners beat NEM 3.0 and rising tariffs with battery leasing and DC coupling, boosting ROI and allowing 20% solar expansion under NEM 2.0.

items.title: POSH Wins Prestigious Re-X Before Recycling Prize
items.summary: Posh Energy has been selected by the U.S. Department of Energy as a winner of the Re-X Before Recycling Prize — recognition for designs that extend battery life through reuse and refurbishment before end-of-life recycling.

items.title: Can Solar & Battery Microgrids Power Elon Musk's Gigafactory of Compute?
items.summary: Posh Energy analyzes the solar and battery microgrid needed to power Elon Musk’s AI Gigafactory, covering energy demand, system cost, and payback period.

items.title: June 2024 Newsletter: Key Insights from Solar Installers on BESS
items.summary: This month we hosted a group of renewable energy experts and solar installers at our Hayward facility. We learned a ton from these on field experts and shared with them about what we are working on behind the scenes to make the ideal BESS for C&I application.

items.title: Posh Featured in World Economic Forum: 5 Battery Storage Innovations Powering the Clean Energy Transition
items.summary: The World Economic Forum spotlighted Posh among the battery technology innovators pioneering the next generation of energy storage — from data centers to road transport.
